item.title: [GOOD] Public Projects Mandated to Use Local Products

Category: Good

This policy aims to boost domestic industries, create local employment, and reduce reliance on imports, thereby strengthening the national economy.

Why this matters: Promoting local industries through government procurement is beneficial for domestic economic growth and job creation.

item.description:
Category: Bad
